sources.entry: XCSnippetsApp - Explore, view, and edit Swift and iOS code snippets for Xcode. [![OSS][OSS Icon]](https://github.com/MarcoEidinger/XCSnippetsApp) ![Freeware][Freeware Icon]

summary.one_liner: A macOS app for browsing, editing, and adding Swift and iOS code snippets from the community to Xcode.
summary.what_it_does: The app lets you explore a collection of code snippets from the Swift and iOS community, described as nearly 200 snippets sourced from several open-source repositories. You can filter snippets by language and platform. You can edit a snippet's Title, Summary, Code, and Completion before adding it to Xcode. The README also mentions in-app download of new snippets from the community. Contributors can host snippets in a public GitHub repo or submit them through a pull request.
use_cases: find iOS code snippets for Xcode
edit snippet title, summary, and code before saving
share my own Xcode snippets with the community
how_to_run: Download the latest version from GitHub Releases.
Copy XCSnippetsApp to your Applications folder.
notable: Filter snippets by language and platform
Edit snippet Title, Summary, Code, and Completion before adding to Xcode
In-app download of new community snippets
Contributors can submit snippets via pull request or their own public GitHub repo
caveats: The README does not describe the snippet sourcing repositories; the list of links under the snippet credits is empty in the README
The README does not state platform requirements beyond macOS and Xcode
Listed as freeware in the awesome-mac list, but no license is named in the README
